run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T06:59:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by frontend's dependency on the ad service during the ad Deployment's restart. Deployment ad was restarted at 2026-11-17T06:58:13Z (pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt; new ReplicaSet ad-5f8dd7c58d, old ad-554b849958 scaled to 0), and the new pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 reported Ready at 06:58:15Z even though it has no readiness/liveness/startup probe. Its container did not actually listen until 07:04:35Z ('Ad service started, listening on 8080'), with the first served request at 07:06:10Z. From the 07:01Z through 07:07Z minutes, 100% of frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client spans were STATUS_CODE_ERROR, the ad service produced zero oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans, and every frontend GET /api/data server span was an error (0 non-error spans) - the frontend span errors start at 06:59:16Z, exactly the alert start. A smaller, separate contributor in the same minute range is the payment restart: checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans errored in the 07:01Z minute because payment's gRPC server only logged 'started on port 8080' at 06:59:37Z after its own 06:58:12Z restart, which produced the frontend POST /api/checkout errors. The flagd ConfigMap currently (read at 07:18Z) declares adFailure=on and paymentUnreachable=on, but that does not match the observed path: ad emitted no error-status server spans and was serving normally again at 07:07-07:08, so those settings remain an unconfirmed hypothesis. Telemetry coverage ends ~07:08-07:09, so the error state between then and the 07:18Z alert time is unknown.

claims.text: Frontend error-status spans were 0 through 06:58:16Z, then 44.04 (rolling 59m increase) at 06:59:16Z, matching the alert start time, and the series remained at ~1963 by 07:18:02Z; ad, checkout, frontend-proxy, fraud-detection and recommendation also show error series in the same view, while accounting's and payment's own error series are 0.

The frontend error spans are concentrated on the ad call path: in the same view frontend's server span 'GET /api/data', its internal 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' span and its client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' all carry error status, alongside smaller error counts on 'POST /api/checkout', 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'tcp.connect'; checkout's own 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and client 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' spans are the checkout-side errors.

For frontend span 'GET /api/data', every error-era minute from 07:01:00Z to 07:07:00Z had STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans and zero STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans (126, 78, 120, 112, 96, 126, then 48 errors with 40 successes at 07:07), returning to 0 errors and 98 successes at 07:09:00Z - i.e. essentially all /api/data requests failed for ~6 minutes.

Per-minute error-span counts show frontend at 86 in the 06:59 minute, 728 at 07:01, 316-504 through 07:06, 192 at 07:07 and 0 at 07:09, and checkout errors (128) only in the 07:01 minute; fraud-detection, payment and recommendation show 0 error spans each minute in that view.

Frontend's client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' had ~90-130 STATUS_CODE_UNSET calls per minute before the incident, then 0 UNSET and 126/78/120/112/96/126/48 ERROR calls for the 07:01-07:07 minutes, and 98 UNSET with 0 ERROR at 07:09 - all ad calls from frontend failed during the outage.

The ad service recorded no GetAds traffic at all during the same interval: its server span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' was 90-112 per minute before 06:59 and 0 at every minute from 07:01 through 07:07, and its internal spans 'getAdsByCategory' and 'getRandomAds' were likewise 0; they resumed at 07:09 (100 GetAds spans).

Pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 container log begins with 'Ad service starting.' at 07:02:55.97Z, then 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 07:04:35.97Z, first request-context line at 07:05:57.60Z and first 'Targeted ad request received' at 07:06:10.89Z - i.e. the new ad container accepted no traffic for roughly 7 minutes after the pod started.

otel-demo events show the ad and payment rollouts: Deployment ad scaled up ReplicaSet ad-5f8dd7c58d from 0 to 1 at 06:58:13Z and scaled down ad-554b849958 from 1 to 0 at 06:58:15Z, with pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 scheduled 06:58:13Z, container created and started 06:58:15Z; Deployment payment scaled up payment-5d565cf9b at 06:58:12Z, pod created/started 06:58:15-16Z, old payment-55766d76b9 scaled to 0 at 06:58:16Z.

The ad and payment pod templates carry kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-17T06:58:13Z and 2026-11-17T06:58:12Z respectively, while the images remain ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and ...:2.1.3-payment and all env vars (PORT, FLAGD_HOST=flagd, FLAGD_PORT=8013, OTLP endpoint) are unchanged relative to an unrestarted deployment such as cart - a configuration-only rollout restart.

Both the old and new ReplicaSets of ad and payment define no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe; ad's container has limits cpu=50m/memory=450Mi (requests 10m/225Mi) and payment's limits cpu=20m/memory=160Mi (requests 10m/80Mi), so the pods are reported Ready as soon as the container starts.

New pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 had Ready=True with lastTransitionTime 06:58:15Z (6m20s before its app logged that it was listening) and payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn was Ready=True at 06:58:16Z, while its log line 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' is timestamped 06:59:37.46Z.

Payment's own span counters show 'charge' and 'grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge' at 48 in the 06:59 minute, 0 in the 07:01 minute and serving again from 07:02 (51.2-90 per minute), and its log shows successful 'Charge request received.'/'Transaction complete.' pairs at 07:07:27-07:07:53Z - the checkout->payment failures were a short unavailability window after payment's restart, not payment application errors.

Current cluster state is consistent with a completed rollout: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 for ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 and payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn, and Service endpoints exist for both (ad 100.96.1.149:8080, payment 100.96.1.157:8080; Services are ClusterIP with selector opentelemetry.io/name ad/payment).

The flagd ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config currently declares fault-injection flags adFailure defaultVariant 'on' ('Fail ad service') and paymentUnreachable defaultVariant 'on' ('Payment service is unavailable'), with all other flags (cartFailure, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, adHighCpu, adManualGc, recommendationCacheFailure) set to 'off'.

Pod fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-n79gv has restartCount 1 with lastState terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-17T06:59:59Z (previous instance started 06:27:12Z); the pod is Running and its logs show normal Kafka consumption ('Consumed record with orderId ...') through 07:07:54Z.

Background flagd-related error spans exist independently of this incident: ad's span 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' carries ~1.02 errors/min from the start of the view (06:58Z) and ad's 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean' is 0 until it starts at 07:08; fraud-detection shows the same EventStream ~1.02/min and recommendation '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' ~3-4/min across the whole window.

The ad service was not returning application-level failures: none of its 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' server spans in the whole view carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET), and once it started serving it logged ordinary 'Targeted ad request received / Non-targeted ad request received' lines with no error output; its failure mode was absence of traffic, not error responses.

The current flagd flag values do not match the observed failure path within the window: ad evaluated no flags during its outage ('ResolveBoolean' at 0 until 07:08) and served calls successfully at 07:08-07:09 (frontend ad client spans 98 UNSET / 0 ERROR), and payment logged successful 'Transaction complete.' charges at 07:07 - so adFailure=on and paymentUnreachable=on as read at 07:18Z are not demonstrated to have produced these errors.

fraud-detection's OOMKilled restart at 06:59:59Z was considered as a cause of the frontend alert and rejected: fraud-detection reported 0 error spans in every minute of the window, kept consuming Kafka records normally afterwards, and frontend's failing spans are the ad and checkout/payment call paths, not fraud-detection.

The multi-minute gap between container start and the app binding its port is plausibly caused by the very low container CPU limits (ad 50m, payment 20m): ad logged 'Ad service starting.' only 4m40s after container start and 'listening on 8080' 100s after that, and payment needed ~81s to bind despite a 20m limit; no container CPU throttling or node CPU metrics are available in this Run to confirm it.

Node-level contention on i-068d8c8f254eed0b1 (which hosted both restarted pods, and ~14 of the 21 otel-demo pods) may have contributed to the slow initialization of the new ad and payment containers; no node CPU/memory usage or throttling metrics are available in this Run, so this remains unverified (node conditions alone show Ready=True, no MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure).

The flagd settings adFailure=on and paymentUnreachable=on remain a possible latent fault-injection source (they declare exactly 'Fail ad service' and 'Payment service is unavailable'), but the evidence in the observed window shows unreachable/not-listening dependencies rather than flag-driven error responses, so they are not established as this incident's cause.

Add a startupProbe and readinessProbe on port 8080 to the ad and payment containers (the current and previous ReplicaSets have none) so the Services do not route traffic to a container that is not yet listening, and raise the ad container CPU limit above 50m (or give startup headroom) so its initialization finishes in seconds.

Find out who or what applied the kubectl rollout restart to the ad and payment Deployments at 06:58:12-13Z and whether the restart was part of an intentional change or fault-injection (requires the change_history integration, which is not available in this Run); also record container CPU throttling for these pods to verify the startup-delay hypothesis.

gaps: Jaeger holds no traces after ~2026-11-17T06:42:49Z (its newest data), so there is no span-level trace detail, gRPC status code or error message for the failing frontend->ad and checkout->payment calls during 06:59-07:07.
The frontend container produced no log lines in the queried window (0 bytes read), so frontend's own error messages for GET /api/data and POST /api/checkout could not be read.

Span metrics (traces_span_metrics_*) and container logs stop at ~07:08-07:09, while the alert was still firing at the 07:18:02Z window end; whether errors continued after 07:09 is unknown, and the 07:08-07:09 points may be affected by that truncation.

The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not found in Prometheus rule groups (queries for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and for {severity="warning"} alert rules returned nothing), so its expression and the reported current value 4.4222 could not be verified; the alert labels/annotations used here are untrusted input.

The flagd ConfigMap was read at 07:18Z, after metric coverage ended; whether adFailure/paymentUnreachable were 'on' during 06:59-07:07 could not be verified, and the flagd container wrote no log lines in the window, so no flag-change event could be observed.
The change_history integration is not available, so the identity of whoever applied kubectl rollout restart to Deployments ad and payment at 06:58:12-13Z is unknown.

Kubernetes objects and Events reflect current/recent state only; historical Service endpoint membership, readiness transitions and probe results at 06:58-07:07 could not be read (there were no Unhealthy/probe events in the window).
No container CPU throttling, node CPU/memory usage or restarts-by-reason metrics are available, so the cause of the ~4m40s container-start-to-first-log delay for ad cannot be confirmed.

The OOMKill of fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-n79gv at 06:59:59Z (exit 137, restartCount 1) is a co-occurring change of other origin and was not linked to the frontend error path; its memory cause is unverified.

Span metrics for services other than frontend, ad, checkout, payment, fraud-detection and recommendation were not examined per operation, so those services' health during the window is largely unchecked (accounting and payment error series returned 0).
next_steps: Query container_cpu_cfs_throttled_seconds_total / container_cpu_usage_seconds_total for the ad and payment pods and node-level CPU saturation on i-068d8c8f254eed0b1 around 06:58-07:05Z to confirm or reject the startup-slowness mechanism.
Obtain the change/audit history for Deployments ad and payment (change_history integration) to identify the actor and intent of the 06:58:12-13Z kubectl rollout restart.

Inspect the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule source for RequestErrorRate to confirm the exact expression and the 4.4222 value, and re-check current frontend error rates after 07:09Z with a metric source that has coverage.
Add readiness/startup probes and review CPU limits for ad and payment deployments before the next rollout, then verify no endpoints are populated before the gRPC server binds.

Check whether the flagd flags adFailure and paymentUnreachable were flipped around the incident (flagd/flagd-ui audit or ConfigMap history) so those fault-injection settings can be placed or excluded.

counter_evidence.text: The ad service was not returning application-level failures: none of its 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' server spans in the whole view carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR (only STATUS_CODE_UNSET), and once it started serving it logged ordinary 'Targeted ad request received / Non-targeted ad request received' lines with no error output; its failure mode was absence of traffic, not error responses.

The current flagd flag values do not match the observed failure path within the window: ad evaluated no flags during its outage ('ResolveBoolean' at 0 until 07:08) and served calls successfully at 07:08-07:09 (frontend ad client spans 98 UNSET / 0 ERROR), and payment logged successful 'Transaction complete.' charges at 07:07 - so adFailure=on and paymentUnreachable=on as read at 07:18Z are not demonstrated to have produced these errors.

rejected_hypothesis.text: fraud-detection's OOMKilled restart at 06:59:59Z was considered as a cause of the frontend alert and rejected: fraud-detection reported 0 error spans in every minute of the window, kept consuming Kafka records normally afterwards, and frontend's failing spans are the ad and checkout/payment call paths, not fraud-detection.
